LanguageData.ESCP_Greybeards_Enlist_Letter_Label: The Greybeards have agreed to teach the colony's people. There is no pay and the stairs are long, but the monks are patient.
LanguageData.ESCP_Greybeards_Enlist_Button_Desc: Ask the Greybeards to take your people in as students of the Way of the Voice.
LanguageData.ESCP_Greybeards_Enlist_Requrements_Not_S: Arngeir does not think you are ready. Standing: {0}.
LanguageData.ESCP_Greybeards_Enlisted_To_Hostile_Fact: The Greybeards will not teach those who bring violence to their door.
LanguageData.ESCP_Greybeards_Enlisted_With_Key: Students of the Way of the Voice
LanguageData.ESCP_Greybeards_Menu_Missions_Desc: Small tasks for High Hrothgar. The monks have little to give, but they give it.
LanguageData.ESCP_Greybeards_Provisions_Desc: Plain food carried up the Seven Thousand Steps.
LanguageData.ESCP_Greybeards_Resign_Menu_Text: Leave the Greybeards? They will understand.
LanguageData.ESCP_Greybeards_Resign_Letter_Label: The colony has stopped studying with the Greybeards.
LanguageData.ESCP_Greybeards_Resign_Button_Desc: End your studies at High Hrothgar.
LanguageData.ESCP_Greybeards_Kick_Out_Label_Title: The Greybeards have closed their door to the colony.
LanguageData.ESCP_Greybeards_Work_0_Desc: Sit in silence with the monks and contemplate the Words of Power.
LanguageData.ESCP_Greybeards_Work_1_Desc: Haul food and firewood up the Seven Thousand Steps.
